sources.title: NIST: photoresist and lithography metrology
sources.summary: NIST describes resist chemistry and lithography metrology as semiconductor-manufacturing research topics.

sources.title: DOE: battery critical materials workshop report
sources.summary: The workshop maps material processing, cathodes, cells, packs and downstream applications; it does not establish current supplier contracts.

sources.title: IEA: Solar PV Global Supply Chains
sources.summary: The report separates polysilicon, ingots, wafers, solar cells and modules. Module manufacturing alone does not establish upstream independence.

sources.title: DOE: electric-grid supply-chain report
sources.summary: DOE documents historical transformer supply constraints. These 2022 findings are context, not a live shortage or lead-time forecast.

sources.title: Howmet: engine-product manufacturing locations
sources.summary: Manufacturer location and product listings provide casting and engine-component examples; no buyer-supplier contract is inferred.

sources.title: FDA: drug shortages and manufacturing disruptions
sources.summary: FDA identifies manufacturing, quality, delays and discontinuation among shortage causes. Product-specific current status belongs in the official database.

sources.title: Nabtesco: precision reduction gears and actuators
sources.summary: The product catalog links reduction gears, servo motors and actuator assemblies; country-specific sourcing is not established.

sources.title: BFW: vertical machining centres
sources.summary: The machining-centre catalog is manufacturer evidence of an offered product family, not an audit of imported components.

sources.title: IEA: Global Critical Minerals Outlook 2026
sources.summary: The 2026 outlook discusses concentration, diversification and supply disruptions across mineral stages. Mining and refining require separate assessments.

chains.question: Which semiconductor steps need separate evidence?
chains.answer: Wafer fabrication, equipment production, chemical inputs and packaging each need their own facility and source records. A domestic assembly plant does not prove domestic wafer or tool supply.

chains.question: Does battery-cell production establish material independence?
chains.answer: No. Cell manufacturing and upstream extraction, refining and active-material production are different stages. Chemistry and product qualification affect substitutability.

chains.question: Does an API facility establish drug availability?
chains.answer: No. API manufacturing evidence does not establish finished-dose capacity, product approval, quality release, inventory or current availability. Consult the official product-specific shortage database for current status.
